Cast To TV Screen Mirror – Cast, Mirror & Stream Anything to Your TV!

Turn your iPhone or iPad into the ultimate casting hub. Cast To TV Screen Mirror lets you wirelessly stream your photos, videos, web content, YouTube, IPTV channels, and more — directly to your Smart TV, Fire Stick, Roku, Chromecast, or any DLNA-enabled device. No cables. No hassle. Just tap and cast.

Whether you're sharing vacation memories on the big screen, streaming your favorite online videos, or casting live IPTV channels, TV Cast makes it effortless and instant.

——————————————————
KEY FEATURES
——————————————————

•   PHOTO & VIDEO CASTING
    Stream your entire camera roll wirelessly to your TV. Cast photos as a slideshow or play videos from your gallery in full HD quality — right on the big screen.

•  WEB VIDEO CASTING
    Cast videos and images from any website directly to your TV. If it plays in your browser, you can cast it. Supports millions of websites and online video sources.

•  YOUTUBE CASTING
    Watch YouTube videos on the biggest screen in your home. Simply paste or browse any YouTube link and cast it instantly — no buffering, no fuss.

•   IPTV STREAMING
    Stream live IPTV channels on your TV with ease. Enter your M3U playlist URL and enjoy live TV, sports, news, and entertainment without any complicated setup.

•.  UNIVERSAL DEVICE SUPPORT
    Compatible with Smart TVs, Apple TV, Chromecast, Amazon Fire Stick, Roku, Samsung TV, LG TV, Sony TV, DLNA devices, and more. If it's on your Wi-Fi, TV Cast connects to it.

•.  FAST & RELIABLE CONNECTION
    Enjoy smooth, low-latency casting over your local Wi-Fi network. No third-party accounts required — just connect and stream.

——————————————————
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
——————————————————

Unlock all premium features with a TV Cast subscription:

•  Weekly Plan — $6.99/week
    Start with a FREE 3-day trial. Cancel anytime.

•  Yearly Plan — $49.99/year
    Best value! Full access to all features for the entire year.

   Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.  Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. You   can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iPhone/iPad Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

——————————————————
LEGAL & SUPPORT
——————————————————

•  Privacy Policy:
    https://sites.google.com/view/tvcast-screen-mirroring-policy/home

•  Terms of Use:
    https://sites.google.com/view/tvcast-screen-mirroring-terms/home

——————————————————
GET STARTED IN SECONDS
——————————————————

Ready to cast? Here's how:
1. Download Cast To TV Screen Mirror
2. Connect your iPhone/iPad and TV to the same Wi-Fi network
3. Select your TV from the device list
4. Choose what to cast — photos, videos, YouTube, IPTV, or web content
5. Sit back and enjoy the big-screen experience!

Download Cast To TV Screen Mirror today and transform how you watch, share, and stream. Your big-screen experience starts now.
